description: Alaska Arctic Observatory and Knowledge Hub is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Alaska Fairbanks | International Arctic Research Center; Arctic Research Consortium of the United States; National Fish and Wildlife Foundation (NFWF). Northern Alaska coastal communities can find tools, resources, and scientific support to share their expertise and observations of environmental change. Observations focus on changes in sea ice, permafrost, and coastal waters. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
